results.title: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3
results.description: Every modality on one backbone: six 2B-class models (text, vision, audio, omni, and decision) trained from LFM3-1.7B-Base, including our first omni model and video input for our vision model.

results.title: How to Make a Tiny Desk AI Video: Outstanding Tiny Desk AI Tutorial (Solo or With Friends)
results.description: The model reads your photo literally. A cap, glasses or a bright jacket in the photo usually shows up in the video too. The reference clip. We start from the 17.7-second cut the viral version used, with the captions and sound removed and an AI-generated person in every seat. It's on its third version: on November 3 we rebuilt the back-row-left seat after some photos didn't fully replace the person sitting there.

results.title: What Is HackerTube? Karpathy's HN Video Discovery Guide
results.description: HackerTube is an independent website for discovering YouTube videos through recommendations found in Hacker News discussions. Andrej Karpathy introduced it on October 31, 2026, describing an AI-assisted project built with Claude Code. Think of it as a different doorway into existing videos, organized around a particular community's accumulated interests.
